The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
-#ifdef CONFIG_PCIE_TEGRA194
-#include <linux/pci-acpi.h>
-#include <linux/pci-ecam.h>
```
Reason:
The removal of the Makefile rule for `CONFIG_PCIE_TEGRA194` prevented `pcie-tegra194.c` from being built as a module. Additionally, the `#ifdef CONFIG_PCIE_TEGRA194` around the native driver code limited its compilation to built-in configurations only, which caused build regressions.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+#ifdef CONFIG_ACPI
+#include <linux/pci-acpi.h>
+#include <linux/pci-ecam.h>
```
Reason:
Restoring the inclusion of the necessary headers and removing the `#ifdef CONFIG_PCIE_TEGRA194` allows the native driver to be compiled correctly for both built-in and module configurations, thus resolving the build regressions.
